Daily Reading Plans

Reading Sanctuary & Guide

Theme Pick any bright paper, warm scroll wood, or calm dark study palette.
Scroll Layout Style Ribbon Flow unrolls 3 continuous horizontal tracks; Compact Folio packs wide multi-verse sheets.
Color Coding Subtly highlights Names of God, People, and Places so you spot who & where at a glance.
Clean KJV ¶ Marks Hides old pilcrow (¶) symbols inside KJV verses for smoother reading.
Font Style Match all 3 columns at once, or pick a distinct font per slot below.
Line Rhythm Vertical breathing room between lines of Scripture.
Text Size (18px)
Recover Progress (Unified Backup) Save or restore everything together—Reading Plans, Pins, Prayer List, History, and Themes.
User’s Manual • Hot-Swap Versions: Tap any of the 3 top pills to swap translations anytime. • 4 Reading Modes: Cols (3 synced columns), Stack (vertical cards), Bubbles (swipeable cards), and Scroll (3 East→West ribbons). • Unlimited Pins & Share: Tap Pin (or Shift+Click a range) to save into folders; tap Share to send straight to WhatsApp / Status. • Prayer List: Tap Pray to write specific prayers with Scripture anchors. • Keyboard: W/S scroll, A/D glide East/West, Q/E or Arrows turn chapters, Ctrl+K search.
Import Bible Module (Offline) Add standard MyBible (.SQLite3), e-Sword (.bblx), MySword, or .db modules. Kairos checks book/verse counts & previews verses automatically.
